AcceptanceDecisionIn.description:
AC-6, AC-7: the EP's decision with fresh MFA; 422 `rationale_required` without a
rationale, or with Accept with conditions and no condition.
AcceptanceDecisionIn.title: AcceptanceDecisionIn

AcceptanceDecisionOut.description: The one insert-only decision row (`record_id` UNIQUE, `actor_kind = 'human'` CHECK).
AcceptanceDecisionOut.title: AcceptanceDecisionOut

AcceptanceFlagOut.description: Insert-only; authored by a person (`authored_kind = 'human'` CHECK).
AcceptanceFlagOut.title: AcceptanceFlagOut

AcceptanceSectionOut.description: A questionnaire section from the firm's pinned template version (never a constant).
AcceptanceSectionOut.title: AcceptanceSectionOut

BreachOut.description: CLI-08 g: the banner stays until evaluated, TCWG communicated and remediated (AC-28).
BreachOut.title: BreachOut

ConcludeIn.description:
AC-18: Independent, Independent with safeguards (safeguards required) or Not independent,
by the EP with fresh MFA; 409 `independence_preconditions_unmet` (AC-19).
ConcludeIn.title: ConcludeIn

ConfirmIn.description: AC-17: the three statements ticked, for oneself only (409 `not_self` otherwise).
ConfirmIn.title: ConfirmIn

ConflictCheckIn.description: The intake names to search (at most 50, sealed at rest) and what they are for.
ConflictCheckIn.title: ConflictCheckIn

ConflictResultOut.description:
One match. A redacted row (a client the caller is walled from) carries only `id`,
`redacted`, `match_kind` and `assessment`: every other field is null.
ConflictResultOut.title: ConflictResultOut

EqrCandidateOut.description: ENG-05 c: a Replace EQR candidate with its eligibility ("Not eligible — cooling-off").
EqrCandidateOut.title: EqrCandidateOut

EqrCheckOut.description: One eligibility check, a code and its result; `year` names the cooling-off year.
EqrCheckOut.title: EqrCheckOut

EqrEligibilityApprovalOut.description: The quality owner's insert-only approval (`actor_kind = 'human'` CHECK), never the EP's.
EqrEligibilityApprovalOut.title: EqrEligibilityApprovalOut

IndependenceBlockerOut.description: A banner reason: a registry code and the object it names, never prose.
IndependenceBlockerOut.title: IndependenceBlockerOut

IndependenceConclusionOut.description: Insert-only (`actor_kind = 'human'` CHECK); a later one names what it supersedes.
IndependenceConclusionOut.title: IndependenceConclusionOut

IndependenceSummaryOut.description: CLI-08 a: "{confirmed} of {total} confirmed", the banner reasons and the conclusion.
IndependenceSummaryOut.title: IndependenceSummaryOut

MemberConfirmationOut.description: A member's own confirmation for this engagement; a decline's note is the EP's to read.
MemberConfirmationOut.title: MemberConfirmationOut

NasRowOut.description: A nonattest service on an attest engagement (AC-21); insert-only events behind it.
NasRowOut.title: NasRowOut

PriorAcceptanceOut.description: A continuance's prior year through the `prior_engagement_id` chain, read-only (AC-5).
PriorAcceptanceOut.title: PriorAcceptanceOut

RemindersIn.description:
ENG-05 "Send confirmation request" and CLI-08 "Send reminder": sent by the person
clicking, for members whose confirmation is still requested or declined.
RemindersIn.title: RemindersIn

RiskPartnerReviewCompleteIn.description: The named risk partner completes the review they were asked for (AC-4; TASK-1258).
RiskPartnerReviewCompleteIn.title: RiskPartnerReviewCompleteIn

RiskPartnerReviewIn.description: The EP picks another partner (never the EP) for a High-risk record (AC-4).
RiskPartnerReviewIn.title: RiskPartnerReviewIn

RotationRowOut.description: CLI-08 d: years served from the `prior_engagement_id` chain and role history (AC-27).
RotationRowOut.title: RotationRowOut

ScreeningRecordIn.description: AC-26: a person records the result of a list they checked; nothing is looked up.
ScreeningRecordIn.title: ScreeningRecordIn

SourceRefIn.description: A flag's source: a file version or a request item, never a model output (INV-2).
SourceRefIn.title: SourceRefIn

TeamApprovalOut.description:
ENG-05's footer: "Team approved by {EP} · {date} · changes since: + {person} (awaiting
approval)". `changed` compares the current member set with the approved one.
TeamApprovalOut.title: TeamApprovalOut

TeamApproveIn.description:
The `member_set_hash` of the roster the partner approves (security review): a team that
changed since answers 409 `stale_version`.
TeamApproveIn.title: TeamApproveIn
